t: This is the Ship and Shovell, a Victorian pub on Craven Passage in Charing Cross. It may be unique, because it's made up of two separate buildings on either side of the street, joined underground by a shared cellar. The name honours Sir Cloudesley Shovell, an Admiral of the Fleet who lived from 1650 to 1707. He fought at the Battle of Solebay and the Battle of Texel, and later at Bantry Bay.
